items.title: Custom workout
items.body: Train → Add workout: build your own workout or generate one from muscles, then drop it on any day.

items.title: Your library, one tap away
items.body: Add workout shows your 3 latest workouts. Browse library opens the full searchable list.

items.title: Quick sessions your way
items.body: Pick 15 to 60 minutes and the muscles to focus on. Long-press a tile to add 30 minutes in one step.

items.title: Switch between your gyms
items.body: Your gym keeps every gym you've used with its own equipment. Tap one to switch, also from Account.

items.title: 76 new exercises, calisthenics included
items.body: Muscle-ups, levers, human flag, pistols, more machines, sandbag, sliders and foam rolling. Turn on Rotate variations to change accessories each week.
